facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 78°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 2 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left Bonanza King (6,450 ft) 13 days earlier this year than the midpoint of two of the three earlier seasons on file (2024 and 2025).

evidence.name: Bonanza King
evidence.detail: left May 13; earlier seasons: May 29 (2024), May 23 (2025); 2023: readings jump by more than snow can

facts.text: At Bonanza King (6,450 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 1.9 in, the lowest of three of the four seasons on file (2024 to 2026).

evidence.name: Bonanza King
evidence.detail: 1.9 in on April 13; earlier seasons: 63.1 in (2024), 66.9 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 19 and May 21, carried from the melt-out date at Bonanza King (6,450 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Bonanza King
evidence.detail: melted out May 13, 1,352 ft above the pass; points to March 19 to May 21
